name: embedded-assets
body: Embedded core: `go:embed` bundle of the vendored reveal.js runtime and the unbranded core page shells (deck, error, gallery) only — the core of the tool rather than template assets (global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets, global.constraint.core-unbranded); templates, themes, fonts, logos and starter decks are read at run time from the resolved library. reveal.js is vendored at `internal/assets/reveal/`, copied from the 6.0.2 release package's `dist/` and committed with its `LICENSE`; minimal set `dist/reveal.js`, `dist/reveal.css`, `dist/reset.css`, `dist/plugin/notes.js`, `LICENSE`.
